fr_html: M. HAGERUP termine en disant qu'il a conscience de la grande responsabilité qui lui incombe comme membre de ce Comité, et qu'il ne manquera pas de prendre en considération toute proposition tendant à concilier les opinions opposées.
en_html: M. HAGERUP ended with the remark that he felt the great responsibility resting on him as a member of the Committee and that he would certainly give due consideration to every proposal made with the intention of reconciling opposing opinions.
